A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5
Version 1.0 | 40 original branching events
EXPANSION VOLUME II — THE CONSTRUCTS, THE CITIES, AND THE COMMON FIRE

collection.description: A storyteller wonders whether enormous civilizations could still quarrel over land, power, belief, and resources.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A storyteller wonders whether enormous civilizations could still quarrel over land, power, belief, and resources.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A healer fears that greater ingenuity could multiply suffering.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A researcher insists that invention does not make violence inevitable.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The council speculates about agreements, mediators, and shared rules.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: An elder remembers that a promise is only as strong as people's willingness to honor it.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A parent imagines families seeking shelter while leaders argue.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The villagers discuss how to help displaced people without pretending to know any distant war is occurring.
